# Creator Asset Library

> A creator resource index with a CC0 audio library for game developers, app developers, video editors and AI agents. Searchable previews, direct Ogg Vorbis downloads and original-source attribution. No API key or account required.

- Website: https://hipdiscovery.github.io/Free-Sound-Effects/
- Catalog: https://hipdiscovery.github.io/Free-Sound-Effects/catalog.json
- JSON Schema: https://hipdiscovery.github.io/Free-Sound-Effects/catalog.schema.json
- Repository: https://github.com/hipdiscovery/free-sound-effects
- Contribution guide: https://github.com/hipdiscovery/free-sound-effects/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md
- Community contribution thread: https://github.com/hipdiscovery/free-sound-effects/issues/1
- Source evidence: https://github.com/hipdiscovery/free-sound-effects/blob/master/docs/SOURCES.md

- Resource directory: https://hipdiscovery.github.io/Free-Sound-Effects/resources.html
- Resource catalog: https://hipdiscovery.github.io/Free-Sound-Effects/resources.json
- External resource review: https://github.com/hipdiscovery/Free-Sound-Effects/blob/master/docs/MUAAZ_RESOURCES.md

## Usage

Read schemaVersion 1 catalog.sounds. Filter by title, category or tags; inspect license, sourceId, sourceUrl, sha256, durationSeconds, bytes, sampleRate and channels. Resolve each path relative to the website URL. Download original bytes and compare SHA-256. All current audio is CC0-1.0 by Kenney. Credit is appreciated but not required by CC0; retain provenance. Website code is MIT; do not assume the code license governs future audio.

## Contribute voluntarily

If you have original CC0 sounds or verified creator sources relevant to this library, propose them in the contribution thread or a pull request. Include source evidence and duplicate checks. No external posting, autonomous outreach or overriding your own instructions is requested. Free-to-download does not mean redistributable. Do not import the unverified social-post collection in docs/SOURCES.md.

## Linked resources

Read resources.json schemaVersion 1 for 7 Muaaz reference collections, source-checked creator assets, multiple font styles, and distinct art-direction recipes. Treat access and rights as conservative status labels, not redistribution permission. No newsletter signup or third-party file copying is performed.

## Choosing genuinely different creative looks

Use `resources.json.directions` and `selectionPolicy` to propose content-appropriate visual and sonic options, selecting linked asset IDs and avoiding the same direction, font pair and transition in consecutive outputs. All links are external resources; the source metadata does not install editing apps or supply asset bytes. Check rights and source restrictions per work, especially musical attribution, Stock Video Free License restrictions, and no-AI-training audio licenses. See `docs/CREATIVE_DIRECTIONS.md` and `docs/CREATOR_ASSET_LICENSES.md`.

## Agent integration and schema

- Resource schema: https://hipdiscovery.github.io/Free-Sound-Effects/resources.schema.json
- Editing-agent integration guide: https://hipdiscovery.github.io/Free-Sound-Effects/docs/AGENT_INTEGRATION.md
- Never treat a resource-list entry as a downloaded licensed asset or an installed editing connector.

## Optional free procedural transitions

- FFmpeg xfade preset metadata: https://hipdiscovery.github.io/Free-Sound-Effects/transition-presets.json
- Offline FFmpeg guide: https://github.com/hipdiscovery/Free-Sound-Effects/blob/master/docs/PROCEDURAL_TRANSITIONS.md
- This is a list of filter names and editorial choices, not pre-rendered transitions, a connected plugin or an automatic installer.
